purpose: Implementation details for summarizing the completed controlled repair run.
main_measures: end to end target resolution across all 50 controlled cases
end to end target resolution among cases that received initial actionable feedback
secondary_dynamics: whether the target was ever resolved
whether a later valid graph lost a previously resolved target
whether an output failure occurred after the target had already been resolved
target status in the last validated graph before an output failure
distinct new violation identities by validator
validated_state_note: validated_state means that no actionable feedback remains. no_feedback is reported separately and is not counted as a validated stop.
output_failure_note: An output failure is a scientific trajectory outcome under the fixed runner policy. The failed output is not regenerated. Because an invalid output has no validated graph, it is not described as a graph regression. End to end target resolution follows the runner and counts an output-failure trajectory as unresolved, while last validated target status is reported separately.
grounding_note: Grounding findings are assessor behavior. The analysis does not reinterpret frozen or repair-round grounding verdicts as human ground truth.

bootstrap.overall_sampling: resample controlled cases with replacement within each error category
bootstrap.condition_sampling: resample controlled cases with replacement within the selected error category
bootstrap.interpretation: Bootstrap intervals describe sensitivity to resampling the controlled cases and are not population performance intervals.
